test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"He is solving a complex problem."

options.text: A complex problem is being solved by him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He is solving a complex problem."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a complex problem" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is solving" to "is being solved" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A complex problem is being solved by him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A complex problem is solved." – Incorrect tense (simple present passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"A complex problem has solved." – Grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: **"A complex problem had solved." – Incorrect tense (past perfect active, not passive).
